sentences: Dara and Cleo were on different teams.
Cleo and Yara were on different teams.
Dara and Yara were on different teams.
contradictions.explanation: With only three teams and Dara, Cleo, and Yara all mutually on different teams, each must occupy one of the three teams alone, leaving no room for Finn or Vik, which is not necessarily contradictory alone, but combined with no stated fourth team it strains consistency since three pairwise-different people already exhaust all three teams, making it impossible to determine team assignments for others without contradiction if any additional pairwise constraint arises; however, strictly these three statements alone are consistent, so the real contradiction lies elsewhere.
